subtitles.threat.zatoplenie: The bunker is flooding — urgent protection and water pumping are needed.
subtitles.threat.kapcha: The bunker control AI has glitched — it needs a reboot and diagnostics.
subtitles.threat.kuhonnyy-vzryv: There has been a kitchen explosion — deal with the aftermath fast.
subtitles.threat.napadenie-izvne: People are trying to break in from outside — you need defense and entry control.
subtitles.threat.nashestvie-krys: A rat infestation threatens food supplies and sanitation.
subtitles.threat.otravlenie-vody: The water is contaminated — you must purify it or find a clean source.
subtitles.threat.prizraki: Paranormal activity may drive everyone into panic — stay together.
subtitles.threat.psi-ataka: A psychic attack and stress surge — you need ways to calm people down.
subtitles.threat.stress-virus: An outbreak of a deadly virus — quarantine and protective measures are needed.
subtitles.threat.sryv-ventilyatsii: The air grows heavy, with a metallic taste. A distant hum sounds as if the system is breathing its last.
subtitles.threat.sboy-elektroseti: The lights flicker, emergency lamps flash and die. For a second the bunker is too quiet, then suddenly too loud.
subtitles.threat.pozhar-v-otseke: The smell of smoke arrives without warning. Plastic crackles somewhere behind the wall, and the temperature starts to rise.
subtitles.threat.karantinnaya-vspyshka: One of the survivors develops a fever. By the next day, two more show symptoms.
subtitles.threat.gribok-i-plesen: Dark stains spread in the corners, and the filters grow fuzzy. Breathing becomes unpleasant.
subtitles.threat.parazity-v-zapasah: Strange traces and tiny crumbs are found in the food sacks. Supplies begin to “disappear” faster than they should.
subtitles.threat.obrushenie-tonnelya: A dull thud sounds, then another. The passage to one zone is blocked, and colder air comes from beyond it. You must decide which zone you lose.
subtitles.threat.razgermetizatsiya: A hiss is heard, pressure drops, and condensation beads along the seams. The doors begin to close with difficulty.
subtitles.threat.treschiny-v-stenah: Fine lines spread along the seams, and concrete crumbles in places. At night, rare clicks sound as if something is settling.
subtitles.threat.bunt-i-raskol: An argument starts over something trivial and suddenly grows into open confrontation. People split into camps, and stopping it becomes difficult.
subtitles.threat.shum-v-trubah: At night, knocks and vibrations run through the pipes, as if someone is working inside the walls. Silence no longer exists — even when everything is off.
subtitles.threat.vnutrenniy-sabotazh: Tools go missing, simple things break, or a door “accidentally” stays open. There are too many coincidences now.
subtitles.threat.sboy-dostupa: Locks jam, buttons respond with delay, and doors behave unpredictably. Sometimes the wrong thing opens.
subtitles.threat.toksichnyy-tuman: A caustic haze hangs outside; even through the filters you can taste the bitterness. Any crack suddenly becomes a problem.
subtitles.threat.holodnyy-front: The temperature drops sharply, metal begins to “sing,” and frost appears on the walls. The far compartments become noticeably colder.
subtitles.threat.zagadochnyy-signal: A message comes through, short and fragmented. It sounds like a warning… or a lure.
subtitles.threat.pylnaya-burya: Fine dust rises outside and clogs every crack and filter. Inside, the air begins to smell like dry earth.
subtitles.threat.korroziya-i-syrost: Humidity rises, and metal blooms with rust. Things age many times faster than they should.
subtitles.threat.kondensat-v-otsekah: Humidity rises; droplets gather on the ceiling and wiring. The floor turns slippery, things grow damp, and the musty smell intensifies.
